Hong Kong: gold falls to HK$40,054 a tael as the paper's tape resumes after a three-day filing gap, down 1.85% from the carried-forward price.

Gold now prices at HK$1,070 a gram, silver at HK$15,781 a kilogram (down 2.24%), both from Kitco's verified spot and the HK$/US$7.80 peg midpoint; no single story cleared the trade's attention today, so tonight's post is the tape alone.

香港金飾業界注意：本報牌價缺口今日結束，金價報每兩港幣40,054元，較早前沿用之舊價下跌1.85%；每克1,070元，白銀每公斤15,781元，跌2.24%。今日無單一新聞達到頭條門檻，故只發牌價。
